name: Flickr Material Database
description: Material classification dataset with 10 categories and about 1,000 images; evaluated using 14-fold accuracy. Distinct from the Describable Textures Dataset (DTD). The data is available under the MIT CSAIL release terms; no data is vendored here.
citation: Flickr Material Database: Sharan, L., Liu, C., Rosenholtz, R., & Adelson, E. H. (2009). Recognizing Materials Using Perceptually Inspired Features. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
